mods.name: Custom Fonts
mods.author: Verdant
mods.description: Change all of GD's text to one of 67 free fonts from the internet.

mods.name: Verdant Hacks
mods.author: Verdant
mods.description: The Tab hack menu: Noclip, Safe Mode, Speedhack, hitboxes, practice tools, a replay bot and more.

mods.name: Death Sounds & Best Messages
mods.author: Verdant
mods.description: Play your own sound files when you die, and pop up your own message on a new best. Comes with 3 message packs (Hype, Cozy, Roast) or write your own.

mods.name: Optimizer
mods.author: Verdant
mods.description: Experimental. Tries to smooth out GD on Mac: syncs frames to your screen, keeps GD's timer from holding frames back, and gives GD high priority so macOS doesn't throttle it. Results vary by Mac. Turn on the frame graph to see your frame timing (red bars = stutters).

mods.name: Puppy Difficulties
mods.author: Verdant
mods.description: Every difficulty face becomes a chunky cartoon puppy, from sleepy N/A and robot Auto up to the flaming Extreme Demon pup. Works at every texture quality. New screens show the puppies right away.

mods.name: Cloud Sync
mods.author: Verdant
mods.description: Your GD progress stays the same on all your computers, automatically. Loads your account's save when GD starts and saves it after levels and when you quit, using GD's own account Save/Load. A small badge in the corner shows when it's syncing. If GD ever closed before it could save, it asks which progress to keep instead of overwriting anything.

mods.name: Jukebox
mods.author: Verdant
mods.description: Play your own MP3s as any level's song or as the menu music. Every song card in GD gets a Jukebox button: click it, pick or add a song (with preview), done. No replacing files. Shuffle mode gives every level a random song from your Jukebox.
